scope: Independent read-only source mechanism and proposed design review; no proposed code authored or executed by reviewer

source_facts.fact: Live source DB/WAL/SHM/envelope fingerprints are checked exactly before private DB/WAL fingerprints; current private comparison reuses source identities, so absent source WAL requires absent private WAL.

Verifier only opens accepted private ciphertext path READONLY|NOFOLLOW, applies raw-key semantics and query_only, reads actual schema/integrity, then closes. It does not use immutable mode or URI, and candidate buffers are wiped.
sqlite3WalOpen opens the WAL sidecar READWRITE|CREATE|WAL independently of the main DB read-only flag; Unix CREATE maps to O_CREAT. A missing private WAL can therefore be created.
walIndexRecover initializes empty WAL index then only decodes a WAL header/frames when file length exceeds the32-byte WAL header; an empty file contributes no committed frames.
WAL close deletes/truncates only after successful exclusive DB lock and checkpoint. Unix read-only main DB uses O_RDONLY, while exclusive lock uses F_WRLCK through the POSIX locking path.

hypothesis.assessment: Source-supported explanation for wrapper UNAVAILABLE after successful native read on absent-WAL snapshots; no independent retained private-WAL runtime receipt was reviewed yet.
hypothesis.reported_runtime_context: Root/readiness report original WAL-present phase passes but closed/no-WAL branches fail. This source review does not relabel any original failure.

preferred_design.choice: Precreate an explicit empty WAL in the newly owned private snapshot only when captured SOURCE WAL was absent, then enforce exact private identity before and after native proof.
preferred_design.reason: Avoids adding a proof-time absence/empty equivalence. Source absence remains exact; any missing/replaced/nonempty private WAL after sealing refuses.
required_boundaries: Use create-new semantics only inside the unique private directory; never create/truncate the live WAL.
Keep original source identity list unchanged, including absent WAL/SHM; still compare DB/WAL/SHM/envelope, markers and exclusive lease before and after.

Expected private DB identity must remain captured DB hash; expected private WAL must be captured WAL hash or known SHA256(empty) only for captured absence. Do not blindly trust newly fingerprinted replacement bytes as a fresh baseline after copy.
Call the existing fingerprint routine so symbolic links, changed canonical paths and nonregular files still refuse; no length-only bypass.
Keep JNI readonly/no-immutable/query_only and key-zeroing/result mapping unchanged.
Private nonempty WAL must remain exactly captured. Private empty WAL must remain empty and present once sealed; disappearance or any bytes refuse.
preferred_design.closure_expectation: On current Android Unix VFS, the read-only main DB descriptor cannot satisfy the write lock required for WAL deletion/checkpoint; expected empty private WAL retention is source-supported. Keep strict post-check so unexpected platform behavior remains UNAVAILABLE; runtime remains a required gate.

alternative.choice: Allow captured absence to compare equal to absent or fingerprint-validated empty private WAL during proof.
alternative.assessment: Narrowly defensible because empty contains no frames, but weaker proof-time identity than precreation and unnecessary if current native runtime retains the staged empty file. Do not normalize captured nonempty WAL or any live source identity.

meaningful_regressions: Capture absent live WAL leaves it absent and creates a regular zero-byte private WAL; full original live identity preserved.
Initial populated private WAL remains identical to captured source before/after valid native proof; deleted, truncated, replaced or mutated private WAL refuses.

Sealed empty private WAL deletion, nonempty replacement, symbolic link and directory refuse. Rewriting identical empty bytes is unchanged byte identity, not a separately detectable inode-identity gate.
Live absent WAL or SHM becoming even empty must refuse; changes to any live DB/WAL/SHM/envelope refuse.
Private DB mutation before native skips native; mutation during nominal native success refuses; every key buffer still zeroed.

All native outcomes retain meaning: valid raw key VERIFIED; wrong key/corrupt refuses; WAL-dependent schema passes only with captured committed WAL; removing source WAL yields UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA rather than incidental wrapper UNAVAILABLE; older supported schema never migrates.

Add real encrypted diagnostic assertions for private WAL existence/zero-byte content before direct native call and unchanged private/live bytes afterward; host stub success alone is not runtime evidence.
